# OpenNetwork design tokens — web

- `tokens.css`: every token as a custom property in `@layer tokens` (`--surface-base`, `--accent-on-fill`, `--text-size-h1`). Context comes from attributes on any element, nested freely:
  - `data-theme`: `light`, `dark`, `light-contrast`, `dark-contrast` (default `light`);
  - `data-direction`: `on` (default `on`);
  - `data-platform="desktop"` in desktop webviews (Tauri, Electron): fixed, denser type and pointer-sized controls;
  - `data-density="compact"`;
  - `data-motion="reduced"` or `"standard"` (without it, `prefers-reduced-motion` decides).
- `kit.css`: the UI kit (`@layer base` and `@layer primitives`): every implemented component of `kit/components/` as `nd-*` classes over the tokens, including the global focus ring, reduced motion and forced colours. The product declares the order of the layers. Mark a region whose own width should decide how components fit (a card column, a sidebar) with `.nd-container` (CSS container queries); give it a width from its layout, since it no longer sizes to its content.
- `text-styles.css`: the kit's text styles as `.nd-text-<role>` classes, with the script rules (Arabic and Chinese families, no tracking or case, their body leading) by `:lang()`. Headings balance their lines and running text avoids a lone last word (`text-wrap`). It also declares the fallback face the family stacks name: a local Arial scaled to Plex's advance and vertical metrics, so the swap to the web font moves a line as little as possible.
- `reference.html`: every colour role, text style, script, icon and component with its spec, switchable by theme, direction, platform, density and motion. Run `node scripts/serve.ts` from the installed repository and open `http://127.0.0.1:4870/reference.html`; this serves the bundled font files without an external font service.
- `reference-fonts.css`: the reference page's font faces from the canonical manifest. Products serve those manifest files at their own asset paths; this review stylesheet is not a product font installer.
- `icons.json`: the icons and the brand mark to inline (`viewBox` and `body`).
- `tokens.json`: the registry (themes with schemes, directions, platforms), brand seeds, breakpoints in px and rem (custom properties cannot be used in media queries), the kit's text styles by property, and every public token with its property, owner, description and default value.

The page maps `prefers-contrast: more` to the contrast themes (`registry.contrastThemes`) and `prefers-color-scheme` to `registry.systemThemes`.

Nested contexts retain the nearest explicit theme/direction and platform/density in browsers with CSS `@scope` (Baseline March 2026). Declaring the default web platform, comfortable density or standard motion also restores that context after an inherited override. Flat selectors remain for older engines; they do not establish correct palettes through contradictory nested contexts. `just test-browser` exercises reference components, accessible names, keyboard patterns, motion and narrow/wide layout in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

Consume a release: copy this directory from the tag `vX.Y.Z` into the product and record the tag and the directory digest (docs/adr/0001-architecture.md §13). Never edit the copy; update it from a newer tag.
